prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Split layout redesign for pet pick friend screen: Redesign the friend selection screen into a split layout showcasing animated mascot interactions alongside pet choices.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "action": "replay"}]}}
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive custom pet feature design step: Add an interactive pet customization screen before photo upload to configure pet colors and traits.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_customizer", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_customizer": {"headline": "Customize Pet Features", "body": "Adjust color, size, and personality traits before creating your pet.", "layout": "two_column", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "rounded"}]}}
2: [choose_path, redesign] Grid layout redesign for choose path screen: Redesign the choose path selection layout into a structured visual grid without altering text copy.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "grid"}}
3: [home, redesign] Stage layout redesign for waiting screen: Redesign the pet setup waiting screen layout into a stage format featuring interactive pet animations.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage"}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account pet sync hint on sign-in screen: Add an explicit hint explaining that signing in saves and syncs pets across reinstalls.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in links your desktop pet securely to your account so progress is never lost."}}
5: [finish, hint] Desktop tray control hint on finish screen: Add a guidance hint explaining how to access the pet from the system desktop tray.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Click your pet in the desktop system tray to open settings, chat, or hide your companion anytime."}}
6: [adoption, incentive] Official adoption license badge component: Add an official adoption seal badge onto the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Official Desktop Companion License", "style": "highlight"}]}}
7: [sign_in, layout] Centered layout redesign for sign-in screen: Switch the sign-in screen layout to a clean centered view.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "centered"}}
8: [finish, layout] Full bleed layout redesign for home intro screen: Change the home intro screen layout to full bleed for an immersive reveal.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "full_bleed"}}
9: [adoption, new_screen] Pet behavior style screen in adoption flow: Add a new companion behavior selection screen prior to adoption certificate generation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_behavior", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_behavior": {"headline": "Select Companion Personality", "body": "Choose how your pet behaves on your desktop screen.", "layout": "grid", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful"}]}}
